findings.title: Synology C3RB3R Ransomware: Locked NAS Files and Patch Advice
findings.summary_md: GridinSoft reports a 360 investigation from October 29 identifying C3RB3R as a Cerber variant that encrypts Synology NAS files with the .L0CK3D extension. The post links to Synology-SA-24:20 (patched December 2024) and notes the company’s October 29 warning directing NAS owners to update DSM.

findings.title: Synology LOCK3D / C3RB3R Ransomware Attack - Everything You Need to Know
findings.summary_md: NAS Compares details the October 30 analysis identifying C3RB3R, a Cerber family ransomware, and explains the .L0CK3D extension. The report cites Qihoo 360’s findings that the malware targets outdated Synology DSM releases and references protection guidance linked to the vendor advisory.
